interface.description: Wireless interface to use for the access point (e.g., wlan0, wlp3s0).

driver.description: Driver interface to use (nl80211 is standard for modern Linux kernel).

ssid.description: Service Set Identifier (network name) broadcast by the AP.

country_code.description: Two-letter ISO/IEC 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for regulatory compliance.

hw_mode.description: Hardware mode: 'b', 'g', 'a', 'n', or 'ac'. Choose 'g' for 2.4 GHz, 'a' or 'ac' for 5 GHz.

channel.description: Channel number (1–13 for 2.4 GHz, 36–165 for 5 GHz). Ensure channel is valid for selected hw_mode and country.

beacon_rate.description: Beacon frame transmission rate in kbps (e.g., '1000' = 1 Mbps). Optional.

vht_oper_chwidth.description: VHT channel width (0=20, 1=40, 2=80, 3=160, 4=80+80 MHz). Used only with hw_mode=ac.

vht_oper_centr_freq_seg0_idx.description: Center frequency segment 0 index (e.g., 42 for channel 36 with 80 MHz width). Required with hw_mode=ac and vht_oper_chwidth ≥ 2.

wpa_passphrase.description: WPA pre-shared key as ASCII passphrase (8–63 characters). Prefer over wpa_psk. Leave blank to use wpa_psk.

wpa_psk.description: WPA pre-shared key as 64-character hex string. Required only if wpa_passphrase is not set.

macaddr_acl_mode.description: MAC ACL mode: 0=accept all (default), 1=accept only listed, 2=reject listed.

macaddr_acl.description: List of MAC addresses to allow/deny (depending on macaddr_acl_mode). Format: 'aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff'.

items.description: A MAC address in standard colon-separated format.

hide_ssid.description: If true, broadcast SSID is hidden (0 beacons, or null SSID). Not recommended for usability/security tradeoffs.

bridge.description: Bridge interface to add the AP to (e.g., 'br0'). Leave empty to run standalone.

enable_dot11d.description: If true, broadcast 802.11d country information element. Required in some countries.

enable_dot11h.description: If true, enable 802.11h (DFS/TPC) — required for some 5 GHz channels.

enable_wds.description: If true, enable WDS (Wireless Distribution System) for repeater or mesh behavior.
